final_report: The patient exhibits severe multi-organ dysfunction including recurrent grade 4 neutropenia and grade 3 thrombocytopenia indicating poor bone marrow reserve, cardiovascular instability (angina, hypertension, hypotension), persistent renal impairment, and progressive functional decline (falls, weakness, dyspnea). These features collectively reflect cumulative treatment-related damage and reduced cardiopulmonary reserve, leading to high mortality risk.
